column1: # The markers of tehas: machine-read notes inside a comment or a body, one
# row per kind of the ports' MarkerKind but Project. Read by the adapters'
# tests and compiled into each adapter; no program reads this file at run
# time, and it is vendored with tehas-ports at the tag.
# Columns, a tab between each: the kind; the open text; the close text, for
# a block, else empty; the fields. In a text, {name} stands for that field's
# value. A field marked ? is optional, and is left out with the space before
# it. Every other field is there once, in the row's order, and a value
# outside its type reads as Unreadable of the row's kind.
# Field types:
#   blueprint        the blueprint's number, decimal, no leading zero; a
#                    marker of another blueprint than the item read does
#                    not read
#   number(n)        decimal, no leading zero, at most n digits
#   numbers(a-b,n)   a to b of number(n), commas between, no space
#   words(a|b)       one of the words listed
#   word(n)          at most n of a-z, 0-9 and -, maybe empty
#   hex(n)           exactly n lower-case hex digits
#   key(n)           at most n of letters, digits, - and .
#   link             one word. A Spec block's first enclosed line is
#                    `Spec: {link} sha256:{sha256}`
#   requirements(1-) the block's lines `- <id> met: <note>` or
#                    `- <id> not met: <note>`, at least one, each id once,
#                    no backquote in an id, a note never empty
#   text             the block's enclosed text, its payload, never the body
# A 1.x Millwright marker named fixer reads as Unreadable of Millwright.
